principles: Track reproducible code, not bulky generated data
Make the experiment code auditable via the canonical-repo review gate
Keep the product repo clean (data lives with the paper)
drivers: Re-establish the section-6 experiment code in the canonical repo
Avoid dumping experiment output into the product repo

options.name: code-only-onboard-fresh-story
cons: Re-reviews bytes already reviewed in the legacy B-add9

options.name: cherry-pick-legacy-merge
cons: The legacy merge is unreachable from proofbound main; cherry-picking bypasses proofbound's review gate (defeats the auditability goal)

options.name: code-plus-data-onboard
cons: Dumps 14 bulky .jsonl data files into the product repo; duplicates the paper repo

rationale: A fresh gate-reviewed story in proofbound re-establishes the harness code auditably in the canonical repo; cherry-picking the unreachable legacy merge would bypass the gate, and tracking the .jsonl would pollute the product repo.

preMortem.consequence: Bulky data dumped into the product repo
preMortem.mitigation: Add only the explicit non-jsonl files; verify git ls-files shows no .jsonl

preMortem.trigger: A reference-solution does not pass its own acceptance/ground-truth
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-005 runs each reference-solution against acceptance + ground-truth before DONE

preMortem.scenario: Verification triggers the expensive LLM loop
preMortem.mitigation: Verify fixture self-consistency only, never the live loop
